description: This Java class 'DevicePanel' manages the UI components and interactions for displaying connected Android devices and their debuggable clients within the Android Studio environment. It handles device connection/disconnection, client list updates, and provides toolbar actions for device-related operations.

classes.name: DevicePanel
classes.description: Main class managing the device and client UI components, device connection/disconnection, and toolbar actions within Android Studio.

methods.name: DevicePanel
methods.description: Constructor initializing the device panel, setting up device and client listeners, and UI components.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Removes listeners and cleans up resources when the panel is disposed.

methods.name: getContentPanel
methods.description: Returns the main UI panel containing device and client lists.

methods.name: clientChanged
methods.description: Callback for client change events (empty implementation).

methods.name: deviceConnected
methods.description: Handles device connection events, updating the device list.

methods.name: deviceDisconnected
methods.description: Handles device disconnection events, updating the device list.

methods.name: deviceChanged
methods.description: Handles device property changes, updating UI and client list if necessary.

methods.name: updateClientsForDevice
methods.description: Updates the list of clients for a specific device.

methods.name: getToolbarActions
methods.description: Returns a group of actions for device-related toolbar functionalities.
